hero: Odisha features on both sides of the investment ledger: a supplementary budget and ACME’s green ammonia decision, while bulk Scotch faces a customs barrier despite the UK trade pact. Prison reform, outbreak surveillance and Google’s India assistant rollout round out the edition; Cyclone Akvan’s forecast landfall is tomorrow’s immediate risk.

cards.headline: ACME takes final investment decision on $3.6 billion Odisha green ammonia project
cards.brief: Mint reports that ACME has taken the final investment decision on its $3.6 billion Odisha green ammonia project. The 760,000-tonne facility is expected to be commissioned by 2029 and supply buyers in India and Japan; Brookfield has committed $600 million to ACME’s green molecule business.
cards.mechanism: Moving an ammonia project through its investment decision can bring low-carbon fertiliser inputs closer to supply, while leaving construction and commissioning risk ahead.
cards.watch: Watch for construction milestones and commissioning updates to test whether the planned supply reaches buyers on schedule.

cards.headline: Odisha tables ₹24,150 cr supplementary budget, food subsidies get big share
cards.brief: Business Standard reports that Odisha has tabled a ₹24,150 crore supplementary budget. Allocations include ₹8,389.76 crore for food supplies and ₹5,100 crore for disaster response; the supplementary outlay is nearly 7.8 per cent of the annual budget.
cards.mechanism: Additional budget provision can support food access and disaster response, with its economic effect depending on subsequent spending.
cards.watch: Watch for approval and disbursement records to distinguish the proposed fiscal provision from relief delivered.

cards.headline: Govt imposes 162.5% duty on bulk scotch imports despite UK trade pact
cards.brief: Business Standard reports that India is imposing an effective 162.5% levy on bulk Scotch imports, above the pre-trade pact rate. A customs classification dispute has left over 80 containers stuck at ports.
cards.mechanism: Classification disputes can raise landed costs and tie up inventory even when a trade pact promises lower tariffs.
cards.watch: Watch for a customs clarification or container releases to determine whether the border bottleneck eases.

cards.headline: Centre notifies new prison law for Andaman and Nicobar Islands, bans caste bias, allows open jails
cards.brief: Hindustan Times reports that the Centre has notified a new prison law for Andaman and Nicobar Islands that bans caste bias and allows open jails. The regulation replaces three existing laws, including two dating to the colonial era.
cards.mechanism: Changing the legal framework can reshape prison administration and custody options, with practical gains depending on implementation.
cards.watch: Watch for implementation rules and prison-level compliance evidence to assess whether the new safeguards change conditions.

cards.headline: ICMR launches infectious disease surveillance network for early outbreak warnings
cards.brief: Hindustan Times reports that ICMR has launched an infectious disease surveillance network for early outbreak warnings. It aims to use real-time or near real-time health data for immediate analysis and feedback on investigations of potential outbreaks.
cards.mechanism: Faster health-data feedback could shorten the interval between an outbreak signal and an epidemiological response.
cards.watch: Watch for coverage and response-time reporting to test whether the network improves the speed of outbreak investigation.

cards.headline: Google Begins Rolling Out Personal AI Assistant, Tasks, In India
cards.brief: Inc42 reports that Google has begun rolling out its personal AI assistant Tasks in India. The summary describes the assistant as agentic and says it was formerly called Gemini Sparks.
cards.mechanism: Local rollout could broaden access to agentic assistance, while useful adoption will depend on reliability and user control.
cards.watch: Watch for India availability details and demonstrated task performance to separate rollout access from dependable automation.
